evidence_requirement: a per-detector output pair (good, broken) with a byte-diff verdict; identical output is reported as INERT with the detector name, never summarised as 'all clean'
question_or_target: Target: run every registered detector against BOTH its known-good and known-broken fixture and report the ones that produce identical output in both. Ledger precedent: a codex-exec probe printed nothing in the broken state too and was one step from being reported as verification. How many currently-shipped detectors are inert?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one fresh-context adversarial reviewer from the OTHER vendor than the author (Claude author -> Codex reviewer, and the reverse); a same-vendor reviewer inherits the author's blind spots
title: Silent-in-both-states scanner over the existing detector inventory
